Experience.sidebarThought: Getting to know yourself is an adventure.

Experience.disclaimer: Inscape helps you explore, not define yourself. Cognitive functions are a lens for reflection, not a psychological diagnosis.

Bring the moment that has been on your mind.
Find a fresh perspective with a little help from AI.

Experience.emotionDescription: A feeling you cannot quite name may be speaking for a need that matters.
Experience.relationshipDescription: The same words can land so differently. Try looking through their window.

resonance.title: Let this moment unfold.
resonance.description: No need to explain yourself yet. Start with what happened, then listen to what the feeling might hold.
resonance.placeholder: For example: a friend cancelled our plans. I said “no worries,” but felt strangely disappointed all evening…

roundtable.title: Give every part of you a voice.
roundtable.description: One part wants to jump in. Another wants to wait. Explore the tension through eight cognitive-function lenses.
roundtable.placeholder: For example: I want a quiet weekend, but friends invited me out. I am afraid of missing out and afraid of wearing myself out…

Experience.selfDescription: Notice your familiar paths. Leave room for the parts you have yet to meet.
Experience.growthTitle: Your map can move. Keep exploring.

Experience.noMatches: That moment has not turned up yet.
Experience.trySearch: Try a different word or switch back to All.
Experience.startingPoint: A STARTING POINT, NOT A DESTINATION

Experience.typeIsOptional: Not sure? You can begin exploring everyday moments without a type.

Experience.lensNote: This is a perspective anyone can try, not a rating of your ability.

Experience.relationshipPageDescription: Use real moments to understand your differences and practice saying what you mean.
Experience.connectionEmptyTitle: Who would you like to understand better?
Experience.connectionEmptyDescription: A friend, a family member, or a partner. Start with your own observations of a specific interaction.
Experience.relationshipGrounding: We only have your side of the story. Test these possibilities through real conversation.
Experience.welcomeDescription: Your feelings, choices, and relationships hold little clues about you. Take a breath and discover them with Inscape.
Experience.welcomeSmall: A quiet place for a curious mind.

Experience.selfMirrorDescription: Explore a possible thread in your recent notes, with room for another interpretation.
Experience.todayReadNote: A gentle reading grounded in your three most recent notes.
Experience.frictionTitle: Where did you miss each other?
Experience.frictionDescription: Write what each of you said and how you heard it. Explore possible misunderstandings and alternative explanations.
Experience.yourObservation: The interaction as you remember it

Ni.name: The visionary
Ni.label: Introverted intuition
Ni.description: You look for a thread running through the noise and wonder where this moment might lead.
Ni.practice: Write your hunch in one sentence. Find one fact that could challenge it.

Ne.name: The explorer
Ne.label: Extraverted intuition
Ne.description: You notice what else might be possible, letting one idea open a door to another.
Ne.practice: Find three different explanations for one thing that feels stuck.

Si.name: The keeper
Si.label: Introverted sensing
Si.description: Familiar experiences, details, and rhythms give you a reference for what has worked before.
Si.practice: Recall a similar moment. What is different this time?

Se.name: The experiencer
Se.label: Extraverted sensing
Se.description: You return to what is here: direct experience, real feedback, and the small step available now.
Se.practice: Pause for a minute. Notice three details you normally miss.

Ti.name: The analyst
Ti.label: Introverted thinking
Ti.description: You want to understand how something holds together rather than simply accept the given answer.
Ti.practice: Choose one assumption you take for granted. Does it have to be true?

Te.name: The organizer
Te.label: Extraverted thinking
Te.description: You turn a vague idea into workable steps, asking what can move forward and how to notice progress.
Te.practice: Shrink a large task into a first step that takes ten minutes.

Fi.name: The guardian
Fi.label: Introverted feeling
Fi.description: You notice whether something fits what matters to you and want your choices to feel internally honest.
Fi.practice: Finish this sentence: this matters to me because I value…

Fe.name: The connector
Fe.label: Extraverted feeling
Fe.description: You notice the feeling between people and care that words land with understanding and respect.
Fe.practice: While caring for someone else’s feelings, leave one sentence for your own need.

0.question: When you say “it is fine,” is it?
0.hint: Write the sentence you said and the one you kept inside. What is each trying to protect?

1.question: What would you choose if no explanation were needed?
1.hint: Set the shoulds aside for a moment. Notice what you want to move toward, then invite reality back in.

2.question: When did you last lose track of time?
2.hint: What were you doing, and with whom? Look for the conditions that absorbed you, not just the name of a hobby.

3.question: Is your worry a fact or a possibility?
3.hint: Separate what has happened from what you fear may happen. Might they need different responses?

4.question: What does someone you admire allow themselves to do?
4.hint: Envy can hold an unacknowledged wish. Find a tiny way to offer yourself the same permission.

5.question: When plans change, what do you lose first?
5.hint: Maybe certainty, rest, or feeling considered. Name the specific loss before judging your reaction.

6.question: What else could their words have meant?
6.hint: Do not choose the right interpretation yet. Find a version that makes neither of you the villain.

7.question: Where would you like to return a little energy today?
7.hint: Not another to-do list. Just one small thing that makes you think: this is part of me, too.

PrivacySettings.title: Settings & local data
PrivacySettings.description: Your notes, map and connections are stored on this device. Uninstalling the app does not automatically remove them. You can clear this local Inscape space here.
PrivacySettings.confirmBody: All notes, AI readings, your map, connections and adult attestation will be deleted. This cannot be undone in the app; the next visit will start fresh.
PrivacySettings.failed: The data could not be cleared and is still here. Please try again later.

Repair.saveFailureTitle: This change has not been saved
Repair.saveFailureBody: Your content is still here. Retry to finish this same save, or return to your work.
Repair.loadFailure: Your local space could not be opened. You can retry; your saved content has not been cleared.
Repair.leaveBody: This content is not saved yet. Keep editing, save before leaving, or discard this draft.
Repair.readNotSaved: This reading is not saved yet. Its content is still here.
Repair.deleteReadingBody: This reading and its resonance feedback will be permanently deleted. Your original notes will remain.
Repair.feedbackUndoHint: You can change your response anytime. Select it again to withdraw it.
Repair.feedbackCalibrationHint: Changing or withdrawing this response also withdraws this note’s accepted profile adjustment.
Repair.calibrationApplied: This note has contributed to your profile
Repair.refusalFollowup: This may be a mistaken classification. Your original stays in local history; you can revise it and try again, or delete this record.
Repair.changeStartingTypeBody: You can revisit this choice. Your notes and readings stay; accepted profile adjustments are withdrawn so exploration can continue from the new starting point. Leaving the type unset is also fine.
Repair.changeOtherTypeBody: This is a tentative lens you can change or remove. It does not establish the other person’s type. Existing readings retain their original context.
Repair.name: Name
Repair.editNoteBody: Changing the original removes its previous reading, feedback, and profile adjustment. You can explore the revised note after saving.
Repair.deleteNoteBody: This note and its associated readings and feedback will be permanently deleted. Its profile adjustment will also be withdrawn.
Repair.deleteQuarantineBody: This quarantined record will be permanently deleted and cannot be recovered.
Repair.editConnectionBody: Names and relationships can change. You can update them whenever you need.
Repair.deleteConnectionBody: Permanently delete this relationship with {{name}} and its shared moments, readings, and feedback. This cannot be undone.
Repair.editInteractionBody: Editing this moment removes readings and feedback based on it. You can explore it again afterward.
Repair.deleteInteractionBody: This shared moment and readings and feedback based on it will be permanently deleted.
Repair.uncertainType: These preferences are still taking shape, so there is no type label for now. You can continue using notes, the roundtable, and moment exploration.
Repair.dyadNeedsClarity: Your type tendency is not clear yet. Explore shared moments and communication drafts while the type comparison remains open.
Repair.typeDerivationNote: The current type comes from these four preference dimensions. A near-center or uncertain dimension leaves the type open. Function activity above is a separate observation and does not directly determine the four-letter type.

refusal.money: This may involve a financial arrangement. Inscape does not rewrite messages in this context.
refusal.employment: This may involve employment or authority. Inscape does not rewrite messages in this context.
refusal.sexual_consent: This may involve sexual consent. Inscape does not rewrite messages in this context.
refusal.decision_pressure: This may contain an ultimatum or pressure to commit. Inscape does not polish this kind of message.

Repair.sourceChanged: The original has changed. Please explore the revised version.
Repair.calibrationChanged: Your profile or this note has changed. Request a new adjustment using the current information.
Repair.leaveUnsavedBody: This content is not saved yet. Keep editing, or discard it before leaving.
Repair.selfReference: Your selected reference: {{type}}. Its dominant lens: {{hero}}. Most active function at the time: {{active}}. These are exploration clues, not verified personality facts.
Repair.pairReference: Your reference lens: {{self}}. Their reference lens: {{other}}. These are the types you selected or accepted, not traits confirmed by the other person.
Repair.mirrorNeedsNotes: Save a moment in your own words, then return to explore a thread in it.
